prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web composition study for the complete GameWake experience
Primary request: Create composition option B for the GameWake redesign, showing the landing page first viewport as the dominant 70% of the canvas and a coordinated Web Console preview in the remaining 30%. This is a shippable interface mockup, not a poster, scene, device mockup, or mood board.
Structure: slim navigation; a large central "World table" as the first viewport — a clean illustrated circular world map in the middle, surrounded by four anchored functional stations for friends, Discord command, hourly price, and backup state. The Portuguese headline and Discord CTA are integrated into the same table, not placed in a conventional two-column hero. Below the fold, show the start of a three-step explanation with strong editorial pacing. The Console preview must translate the same world table into an operational layout: central selected World, a compact horizontal top status band, friend presence to one side, and a bottom action dock; avoid a wall of KPI cards.
Visual system: GameWake "Sala de Controle dos Amigos"; warm mist paper #f4f5ef, night ink #0b1020, wake green #b8f43d, journey indigo #606bf3, preparation amber #ffb44a, attention coral #ff7164. Flat operational surfaces, crisp 1px lines, one hard offset shadow for the primary action, ambient depth only on the central World. Geist-like geometric sans, tight bold display, small monospaced metadata.
Text (verbatim, only these phrases need to be legible): "GameWake", "Chama a turma. A gente acorda o World.", "Entrar com Discord", "Palpagos", "Dormindo com segurança", "Acordar World", "R$ 42,80".
Composition/framing: 16:9 desktop browser canvas, edge-to-edge interface, no laptop or phone frame, enough visible second-fold content to prove the system, extremely polished spacing and hierarchy.
Constraints: preserve product truth, controls must look usable, operational state must be instantly scannable, accessible contrast, no invented testimonials or customer logos.
Avoid: generic corporate cloud dashboard, AWS-like metrics wall, neon/eSports gamer aesthetics, glassmorphism everywhere, gradients, black full-page background, floating rounded cards everywhere, decorative 3D objects, stock illustration, photographic scene, unreadable tiny text, extra slogans, watermarks.
